note: EU steel and aluminium additional duty is 0 for all of 2022. The tariff-rate quota from 1 January 2022 is treated as replacing the tariff. HTS 2022 revision 12 headings 9903.80.01 and 9903.85.01.
Canada, Mexico and Australia: no additional duty on steel or aluminium. Argentina: the heading excepts Argentina; the quota is treated as replacing the tariff.
Brazil and Korea: no additional steel duty (heading 9903.80.01 excepts them). They are not excepted from the aluminium duty, which stays at 10 percent.
Japan steel: 1 April 2022 start, so 3 months at 25 percent and 9 months at 0. Japan is not excepted from aluminium.
United Kingdom steel and aluminium: 1 June 2022 start (Proclamation 10406), so 5 months at the tariff and 7 months at 0.
Ukraine steel: Proclamation 10403 suspends the steel duty from 1 June 2022, so 5 months at 25 percent. Ukraine is not excepted from aluminium.
Every other partner: the 25 percent steel duty and the 10 percent aluminium duty apply for the whole year.
